prop_starter_streetlight_main_a_v01.glb.description: A full-height municipal main-street lamp for Dreamdrop District with a flared cast-metal base, tapered steel pole, lockable maintenance panel, substantial horizontal mast arm, believable cable/service joints, and a rectangular LED roadway luminaire with a glass lens and heat-dissipation ribs. The proportions must read as real street infrastructure rather than a decorative toy lamp.
prop_starter_streetlight_main_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Ordinary contemporary American civic equipment, slightly stylized for clean long-distance readability, with enough hardware and layered construction to hold up at sidewalk distance.
functionalNotes: light lens separated for emissive control

prop_starter_streetlight_residential_a_v.description: A quieter neighborhood streetlight for Willowbend with a shorter tapered pole, decorative but believable base collar, curved shepherd-style arm, compact downward-facing LED fixture, maintenance access panel, mounting bolts, and subtle warm residential lighting. It should fit detached homes and curved local streets without becoming ornate fantasy furniture.
prop_starter_streetlight_residential_a_v.designIntent: Warm, modest municipal lighting that visually separates residential streets from downtown arterials while remaining mechanically credible.

prop_starter_traffic_light_a_v01.glb.description: A complete signalized-intersection assembly with a bolted pedestal, tapered vertical support, reinforced mast arm, cable junctions, two suspended three-lens vehicle signal heads, deep visibility visors, red amber and green lenses, backplates, a pedestrian signal box, and a push-button/control panel at accessible height. The assembly must look engineered to survive weather and traffic vibration.
prop_starter_traffic_light_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Readable modern traffic infrastructure for Dreamdrop Cross, with separate lenses and signal heads for future gameplay state changes.
functionalNotes: signal heads remain separate child objects
forbiddenShortcuts: three colored circles stuck to a pole
single flat texture pretending to be all hardware

prop_starter_stop_sign_a_v01.glb.description: A regulation-style roadside stop sign with a correctly proportioned red octagonal aluminum face, narrow white border, raised readable STOP lettering, galvanized perforated post, rear mounting brackets, fasteners, and a small concrete footing collar. The face should be thin metal, not a thick red toy block.
prop_starter_stop_sign_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Immediately recognizable traffic control signage with front and rear construction detail.
functionalNotes: sign face oriented toward positive Z

prop_starter_street_name_sign_a_v01.glb.description: A municipal cross-street sign assembly with two perpendicular enamel sign blades labeled DREAMDROP BLVD and CENTRE AVE, reflective borders, rounded blade ends, a capped galvanized pole, mounting collars, bracket hardware, and a sturdy base connection. Lettering must be modeled or converted to mesh so the sign remains readable in the exported GLB.
prop_starter_street_name_sign_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Functional wayfinding that helps the city read geographically instead of relying on floating UI labels.

prop_starter_district_sign_a_v01.glb.description: A substantial pedestrian-scale district gateway marker with a low brick-and-stone plinth, inset painted-metal sign panel reading DREAMDROP DISTRICT, raised border trim, side masonry piers, a shallow cap, concealed uplight fixtures, small mounting seams, and landscaping clearance at the base. It should feel like permanent city wayfinding, not a billboard or theme-park prop.
prop_starter_district_sign_a_v01.glb.designIntent: A civic identity marker using Starter Town brick, cream stone, navy metal, and restrained gold accents.

prop_starter_fire_hydrant_a_v01.glb.description: A believable cast-iron municipal hydrant with a broad bolted ground flange, tapered barrel, segmented body collars, domed bonnet, top operating nut, two opposing side hose outlets with hexagonal caps, cap chains, wrench lugs, drain/service details, and eight visible base bolts. Painted red surfaces should show subtle roughness variation while metal caps and bolts remain distinct.
prop_starter_fire_hydrant_a_v01.glb.designIntent: A compact hero-quality street prop whose mechanical function is obvious from every angle.
functionalNotes: simple cylindrical collision may be generated separately

prop_starter_utility_box_a_v01.glb.description: A weather-resistant municipal electrical/telecom cabinet on a concrete equipment pad, with a beveled painted-steel enclosure, inset front service door, piano hinge, recessed latch, warning placard frame, upper and lower ventilation louvers, roof drip edge, rear conduit entries, grounding lug, and base anchor bolts. The cabinet should look installable and serviceable, not like a plain gray cube.
prop_starter_utility_box_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Believable city infrastructure for downtown sidewalks, alleys, and industrial edges.
functionalNotes: front service side faces positive Z

prop_starter_bench_a_v01.glb.description: A durable three-seat public bench with separate hardwood seat and back slats, curved powder-coated steel side frames, integrated armrests, rear support rails, slat mounting bolts, anti-skate center divider, and four anchored feet. Human seating dimensions must be credible, with a comfortable back angle and sufficient structural support beneath the seat.
prop_starter_bench_a_v01.glb.designIntent: A lived-in civic bench appropriate to Dreamdrop sidewalks and Parkside Commons, detailed enough for close interaction shots.

prop_starter_trash_can_a_v01.glb.description: A heavy-duty city sidewalk trash receptacle with a cylindrical internal liner, vertical powder-coated steel slats, top and bottom support rings, a domed rain hood, side disposal opening, hinged service door, latch hardware, drain gap, base anchors, and a visible dark liner through the opening. It must look maintainable by sanitation workers and stable in public space.
prop_starter_trash_can_a_v01.glb.designIntent: A realistic repeatable city prop with enough silhouette and maintenance detail to avoid becoming a generic barrel.

vehicle_techtown_hover_sedan_a_v01.glb.description: A production-feasible four-seat urban hover sedan for Neon Drift Motors with an aerodynamic load-bearing lower chassis, enclosed four-door passenger cabin, tinted windshield and side glass, front and rear crumple volumes, four corner-mounted vector hover pods, protected intake grilles, visible underbody lift rings, service access panels, door seams and handles, front lighting, rear lighting, mirrors or camera stalks, charging port, registration panel, and a stable low hovering stance. The vehicle must read as a practical road replacement, not a floating toy, UFO, or wheel-less box.
vehicle_techtown_hover_sedan_a_v01.glb.designIntent: Sleek cyberpunk transportation grounded in credible vehicle packaging and maintenance logic. Dark composite bodywork carries controlled cyan lighting; glass and propulsion hardware remain functionally distinct.
functionalNotes: vehicle origin at ground-center below chassis
forbiddenShortcuts: car body with wheels merely deleted
hover rings with no mounting or service structure

vehicle_techtown_hover_coupe_a_v01.glb.description: A two-door performance hover coupe with a low aerodynamic nose, reinforced central chassis spine, two-seat glasshouse, pronounced rear power module, four independently mounted vector hover pods, underbody lift emitters, cooling channels, retractable service panels, sculpted side intakes, front and rear lighting, charging connector, camera mirrors, and a wide planted stance. It should look capable of high-speed urban travel while remaining physically serviceable and manufacturable.
vehicle_techtown_hover_coupe_a_v01.glb.designIntent: A premium Neon Drift Motors model with angular dark body panels, tinted glass, and restrained magenta/cyan accents that supports the TechTown cyberpunk direction without becoming a toy racer.
forbiddenShortcuts: wheel-less sports car with empty wheel wells
